name: 软糯油润清香粳米款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating deep cocoa-brown gradient #5C3D26-#3B2A1E and cream beige #F5EFE6, one golden wheat-field landscape panel for the opening
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft top light with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, controlled highlights, appetizing food rendering, never plastic
styleLock.surfaceSystem: warm wood trays and tables, matte cream panels, raised warm platforms
styleLock.typography: modern clean sans-serif headlines only, deep brown #3B2A1E on cream and cream #F5EFE6 on brown, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and gold single-character badges in #D4AF37 only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale, grains and cooked rice shown with realistic matte texture and natural steam, centered stable placement
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm appetizing rice-and-grain food ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep cocoa-brown #5C3D26, cream beige #F5EFE6, golden wheat #C9A876 and one gold accent #D4AF37 with deep brown text #3B2A1E; warm soft top light with gentle fill and soft contact shadows, appetizing realistic grain and steam texture, never plastic; modern clean sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded info labels and thin-line gold badge style; backgrounds alternate between deep cocoa-brown gradient and cream beige with one golden field opening panel; stable product scale and centered placement; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
